# All Black Towns

> All Black Towns documents 120 historic Black towns in the United States: where each town is, how it was founded, what happened to it, and the original song written for it. The site carries a page for every town, an interactive map, in-depth research dossiers with lessons for teachers, and a growing international map of Black towns beyond the United States. It is an education and preservation project by The Elements of Hip Hop.

## Towns and map

- [Interactive map](https://www.allblacktowns.com/map.html): all 120 towns placed, plus 53 international places
- [Town index](https://www.allblacktowns.com/towns.html): every town page, searchable by state and name

## Dossiers (free pilot set)

- [Sweet Auburn, Atlanta, Georgia](https://www.allblacktowns.com/dossiers/sweet-auburn.html): how one Atlanta street became known as the richest Negro street in the world
- [Boley, Oklahoma](https://www.allblacktowns.com/dossiers/boley.html)
- [Nicodemus, Kansas](https://www.allblacktowns.com/dossiers/nicodemus.html)
- [Eatonville, Florida](https://www.allblacktowns.com/dossiers/eatonville.html)
- [Rosewood, Florida](https://www.allblacktowns.com/dossiers/rosewood.html)

Each dossier is a full chaptered history with a timeline, check-for-understanding questions for classroom use, and the town's original song.

## Music

- [Music](https://www.allblacktowns.com/music.html): every town has an original song; song links are also on each town's page and in Chapter 7 of its dossier.

## For teachers

- [Education](https://www.allblacktowns.com/education.html): the classroom layer: chaptered reading, timelines, and questions with an answer key in the print view. The curriculum is in beta and all five pilot dossiers are free in full.
- [Pilot lesson plan: Sweet Auburn](https://www.allblacktowns.com/dossiers/sweet-auburn-lesson.html): the free sample lesson, "The Richest Street in the World."

## Join and contribute

- [Share a Town](https://www.allblacktowns.com/share.html): suggest a town for the record. Join the List signup is on the site; both deliver to info@allblacktowns.com.
- Contact: info@allblacktowns.com
